must_contain: the catalogue's term is LIMS, not LIS
LIMS is the system a diagnostic laboratory uses to manage samples, tests and results
a laboratory uses its LIMS to publish as the HIP, linking each report as its own care context, and to fetch a patient's history as the HIU
notes: reader spelled it LIS; catalogue atom shared.glossary.lims spells it LIMS (laboratory information management system).
